historicalContracts.name: AnchorStateRegistry
historicalContracts.note: Stored the confirmed anchor state root seeding every new dispute game; a poisoned anchor lets invalid withdrawal claims resolve as valid in OptimismPortal2 (opstack/AnchorStateRegistry template is critical today).

historicalContracts.name: OldQuixoticNFTBridge
historicalContracts.note: Deprecated third-party NFT bridge on OP Mainnet; NFTs are not counted in project TVS, so its compromise cannot cause loss/freezing of project funds (consistent with current classification).

historicalContracts.name: L2OutputOracle
historicalContracts.note: Pre-fault-proof state root oracle: a fraudulent output root accepted here (via PROPOSER compromise or malicious upgrade) enables theft of all escrowed funds through OptimismPortal withdrawals after the 7d finalization window (opstack/L2OutputOracle template is critical today).
